guard: the public exchange face keeps the loopback capability gate, throttles a refusal flood per peer without touching another peer or the loopback budget, still mints a valid credential from a throttled key while withholding a refusal's reason, and refuses an unknown agent and a wrong secret with one sentence
why: #799: the public exchange face is unauthenticated and publicly reachable, and its suite had no
fixture for the cells that make it safe: the capless loopback 401 that pairs the public 200, the
per-peer throttle, and the shared refusal sentence that keeps the face from being an existence
oracle. A green run proves the face works, not that any of those cells would notice a regression.
THE ISOLATION CELLS WERE VACUOUS. Since #802 a throttled peer key still mints when its credential
is valid, and the PER-SOURCE ISOLATION and BUDGET SEPARATION cells probed peer B and the loopback
face with a VALID credential. They stayed green with every trusted-proxy peer in one bucket and
with public refusals charging the loopback budget (I7 and I8 SURVIVED before the cells changed).
Both cells now probe with a refused exchange and require its own 401 sentence, not 429, because
only a refusal can tell whether the budget it lands in is already full.
SPECIFIER BOUNDARY. The suite re-execs the registered auth-service command, which loads
`implementations/auth/dist`, so the command builds the package before running and every mutation's
`afterRestore` rebuilds it, or a restored source would sit behind a dist compiled from the mutant.

mutations.name: I1 the loopback face skips the capability gate
mutations.expectRed: NEGATIVE CONTROL: the SAME capless request against LOOPBACK is still 401
mutations.cell: NEGATIVE CONTROL: the SAME capless request against LOOPBACK is still 401

mutations.name: I2 the public per-peer refusal budget never trips
mutations.expectRed: peer A's refusal flood throttles peer A (429)
mutations.cell: peer A's refusal flood throttles peer A (429)

mutations.name: I3 a full bucket refuses before the body is read, valid credentials included (the shape before #802)
mutations.find:
const peerThrottled = policy.throttled(ctx, peer);
  const body = await readJsonBody(req);
mutations.expectRed: A VALID TOKEN STILL MINTS (200) FROM A THROTTLED PEER KEY
mutations.cell: A VALID TOKEN STILL MINTS (200) FROM A THROTTLED PEER KEY - a full bucket must not deny a request that would succeed

mutations.name: I4 a throttled agent refusal returns its specific 401 reason instead of 429
mutations.expectRed: a FAILED exchange from a throttled key is answered 429, not the refusal reason
mutations.cell: a FAILED exchange from a throttled key is answered 429, not the refusal reason

mutations.name: I5 an unknown agent is refused with a different sentence than a wrong secret
mutations.replace: if (!row?.tokenHash) throw new Error("agent exchange refused: unknown agent");
mutations.expectRed: an unknown agent is refused with the SAME sentence (no existence oracle)
mutations.cell: an unknown agent is refused with the SAME sentence (no existence oracle)

mutations.name: I6 a wrong secret is refused with a different sentence than an unknown agent
mutations.replace: if (presented.length !== stored.length || !timingSafeEqual(presented, stored)) throw new Error("agent exchange refused: wrong secret");
mutations.expectRed: an unknown agent is refused with the SAME sentence (no existence oracle)
mutations.cell: an unknown agent is refused with the SAME sentence (no existence oracle)

mutations.name: I7 every trusted-proxy peer shares one failure bucket
mutations.expectRed: PER-SOURCE ISOLATION: a refused exchange from peer B still gets its own 401 sentence while peer A is throttled
mutations.cell: PER-SOURCE ISOLATION: a refused exchange from peer B still gets its own 401 sentence while peer A is throttled

mutations.name: I8 public refusals also charge the loopback face's refused-exchange budget
mutations.expectRed: BUDGET SEPARATION: a refused loopback exchange still gets its own 401 sentence after the public flood
mutations.cell: BUDGET SEPARATION: a refused loopback exchange still gets its own 401 sentence after the public flood
